sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B (free) - API Pricing & Providers | OpenRouter
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is a compact reasoning model from Liquid AI. It is suited for agent workflows, data extraction, RAG, and long-context processing. Liquid advises against using it for agentic coding or knowledge-heavy tasks. Prompts and outputs may be retained and used to train Liquid models.
